definition: In this historical psychology context, collusion means secret cooperation between people to make an apparent mind-reading or muscle-reading feat seem genuine. It refers to deception by working together, contrasted with performances explained by involuntary muscular cues alone.

provenance.revision: 1901 New York Macmillan original; archive index checked 2026-10-18
